text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ————"Hometown."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing that...
what was the first thing
that came to your mind?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Perhaps it's the scenery of my beloved town, filled with so many childhood memories.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps it's the gentle expression of someone
who warms your heart just by being by your side.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—A special place meant just for you,
where you can be at peace, bound by nothing?”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I believe that every single one of those places that came to mind—
is an equally precious 'home.'

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...And I have one too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
An important—
irreplaceable "hometown".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Please, listen.
To the story of my beloved 'hometown'—

Our journey through the Twinkle Series with
Hokko Tarumae had finally begun in earnest, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Tomakomai♪
White lands, paper dancing in the air♪ Ah, Tomakomai♪
Even migratory birds take a little rest...♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That was "Come on Over to Tomakomai,"
written and composed by Hokko Tarumae!
Thank you so much for listening until the end♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to reintroduce myself—the paper-winged migratory bird flown straight from Tomakomai Port! Surf clam enthusiast☆
Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If anyone's interested, I'd love for ya
to check out my Umasta or Umatter♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! I brought handmade pamphlets
introducing Tomakomai's local specialties too!
Everyone, please grab one of these too~!

—Today, too, I helped Hokko Tarumae with her local idol activities from morning,
calling out to people passing by in front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, your Umastagram profile says you're a Tracen student.
So you don't just do local idol work, you race too?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes!
I'm planning to make my debut this year!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
Good luck with your debut race.
I'll follow you for now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪
To live up to everyone's cheers,
I'll give it every single ounce of grit I've got!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I'm gonna sing a new song for everyone who stopped by today!
Please listen to 'Haskap-Colored Dream'♪
After finishing our local idol 'morning routine' in front of the station, the two of us decided to grab a late breakfast at a nearby diner—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—We did it! This morning, our pamphlet distribution rate
and our social media follower growth are both
at an all-time high!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Well, looking at it strictly by the numbers,
it really is minuscule, though.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! Working hard to expand my song repertoire, making promotional accounts, showing everyone what I've got as a pre-debut Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your advice, Trainer,
I can really feel that more people are stopping by to watch than before.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for helping out. Sorry for the trouble.
choice_data_list: A trainer's job is to respect their trainee's dreams

text_block_list.text: Yes, Hokko Tarumae has a dream.

"—I have a big dream: to introduce my hometown of Tomakomai,
Hokkaido to the entire nation,
and liven it up!"

Making a name in the Twinkle Series.
Drawing attention as a local idol from Tomakomai.
Both are necessary to achieve her dream.

Therefore, as Hokko Tarumae's Trainer,
I decided that I would support her in both
her racing and her local idol activities.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I have to work even harder.
Especially with Trainer helping me out like this...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once we return to the academy,
please be strict with the training.
All to hype up Tomakomai even more...!
choice_data_list: Let's get fired up and do this!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And the time for training
at the academy arrived—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...â
How was my acceleration timing just now?
choice_data_list: You can go a bit faster. For example—

text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae listens earnestly to my guidance and strives to improve.
This diligent attitude is one of her greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. Understood.
Next time, I'll focus on sustaining my top speed
and try to accelerate a little earlier.”
choice_data_list: Before that, how about we take a quick break?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it that time already?
In that case, while I still can,
I should make a note of what was said—
Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bug you during training!
I just really wanted to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae's Trainer!
Mind if I barge in for just a moment?
choice_data_list: No, I was just taking a break, so it's fine.

text_block_list.text:
The one who appeared was Copano Rickey.
I've heard she's a friend of Hokko Tarumae and a slightly quirky Umamusume who practices feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
Don't you have your own training for the Debut Race, Rickey—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Your debut race has been decided, right?
I'm here today to cheer you on!
Do your best, Tarumae☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you.
Though, actually running in it
is still pretty far down the road—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, I know!
That's why, so that Tarumae's hard work bears fruit,
I was just going to check the flow of your qi—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Stooop!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I had a feeling you'd say that.
I always tell you I don't rely on feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mmm... I'm only seriously suggesting this because I care about Tarumae, you know...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Mind your own business!
Good grief—"

—Oh dear me.
Now, now, no fighting, you two.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's all get along, okay?
After all, we're all fellow Tracen Academy Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san! When did you... Facebook!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wanna have some crunchy snacks and take a breather?
Tarumae-chan's Trainer-san, you too—
here, go ahead~.

The Umamusume who instantly relaxed the atmosphere
was named Wonder Acute.
Though she had an aura somewhat like a grandma—

She is a bona fide, top-tier Umamusume running at
the forefront of dirt racing, and—

"To Hokko Tarumae, who runs on the same dirt track,
she is someone she might one day compete against—a goal to aim for."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—I'm already looking forward to your debut race.
I'll be rooting for you too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
I plan to work hard so I can run just like you, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Come on~ isn't that a totally different attitude than before?
I'm cheering for Tarumae too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Because it's totally obvious Rickey's ulterior motive is to drown me in feng shui if given the chance!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't make it sound so bad~!
It's 100% goodwill! I just want to make Tarumae happy!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sick and tired of hearing about that.
I don't rely on feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmm, as formidable as ever~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu. They get along so well, don't they—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
A new radiance is just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I need to shine brighter too!

—After finishing training that day,
Hokko Tarumae brought a cardboard box
filled with something into the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Actually, to celebrate starting work toward my debut,
my hometown sent me a whole bunch of haskap juice!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if you'd like to join me.
You like haskap berries, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think I'll gladly take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It kind of reminds me of
the day I first met you, Trainer.

âIt's true, when I first met Hokko Tarumae,
she offered me haskap berries and fed them to me as well.

That faint sweetness amidst the sourness
that I tasted back then—

—That was something I could certainly feel,
even from the haskap juice
I had just received from Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to repay
the warmth of the people of Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As a locodol...
And as a dirt Umamusume...!
choice_data_list: I'll live up to your expectations as your Trainer, too.
As your Trainer, I'll step up and do my part too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once again...
I look forward to working with you!

And so, sealing our vow with haskap juice,
my days with Hokko Tarumae began!
